Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Lucky Draw System source code from Google Apps Script

Backup of the Hui Hotpot \(张崇会火锅\) Lucky Draw System v3.0
source code from Google Apps Script to GitHub for version control.

Files:
- src/Code.js: Server-side logic \(lottery draw, user management, admin\)
- src/Lottery.html: User-facing lottery wheel page
- src/Admin.html: Admin panel for prize/user/staff management
- src/appsscript.json: Apps Script manifest
- .clasp.json: Google clasp CLI config for syncing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Initial commit: Add LDS Excel data file

Hui Hotpot Lucky Draw System v2.1 data file containing:
- Prize configuration
- User data
- Winning records
- System settings
- Staff accounts
- Operation logs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh pr create --title "Add Lucky Draw System source code backup" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Cloned all source code from Google Apps Script project to GitHub for version control
- Added 3 source files: Code.js \(server logic\), Lottery.html \(user page\), Admin.html \(admin panel\)
- Added clasp config for future syncing between GitHub and Apps Script
- Added .gitignore for clean tracking

## Test plan
- [x] All 4 source files \(Code.js, Lottery.html, Admin.html, appsscript.json\) present in src/
- [x] .clasp.json configured with correct scriptId and rootDir
- [ ] Verify live Apps Script web app is unaffected
- [ ] Run `clasp pull` to confirm files match latest Apps Script version

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)" --base main)
